script_type: Unvocalized Ge'ez with South Arabian consonantal markers
thematic_domain: Military Campaign & Pacification of Beja Tribes
key_excerpt: አነ ፡ ዔዛና ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አክሱም ፡ ወሐመር ፡ ወራይዳን ፡ ወስባእ
translation_english: I, Ezana, King of Axum and Himyar and Raydan and Saba and Salhen, son of the unconquered god Mahrem...

key_excerpt: በኀይለ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ዘመራሐኒ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወበምሕረት
translation_english: By the power of the Lord of Heaven, who guided me in righteousness and mercy, I erected this monument...

thematic_domain: Maritime Campaign across Red Sea & Himyar Liberation
translation_english: Consecrated in Christ and the power of the Holy Cross, dispatching the Axumite fleet across the sea...

key_excerpt: በቀዳሚ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ቃል ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
translation_english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, illuminated with Ethiopian pigments...
